name: sovra-language
description: Experimental Sovra diagnostics, checked symbol/type hover, navigation, syntax highlighting and basic suggestions

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Only syntax highlighting is available until the workspace is trusted.

commands.title: Sovra: Build Current File as IR
Sovra: Build Current File as JavaScript

sovra.compilerPath.description: Compiler on PATH or an absolute executable path. Changes require restarting the language server.

sovra.nodePath.description: Node.js 22+ on PATH or an absolute executable path for the language server.

sovra.experimentalGenericPackageDiagnost.description: Opt into whole-package generic diagnostics for unsaved entry/module/dependency buffers. Requires experimentalGenerics and restart. Checked function/type/field definitions, hover and outlines and scope-aware local navigation are available. Diagnostics never execute or save source.

sovra.experimentalGenericPackageTasks.description: Opt into compiler-selected generic package Check/Run targets, including registered modules. Requires experimentalGenerics and restart. Does not enable package diagnostics; saves related sources and refuses dirty manifests.

sovra.experimentalGenerics.description: Opt into standalone generic/Option/Result/? buffer diagnostics and Check/Run tasks. Requires language-server restart; mutually exclusive with experimentalV2. Checked root declaration outlines and local symbolic-type hover/navigation and function-header type definitions are available; syntax-preserving document formatting is available; body/type-parameter navigation and IR/JS tasks are unavailable; package buffers are checked as standalone files by default.

sovra.experimentalV2.description: Opt into v2 standalone buffer diagnostics, formatting and source tasks. Requires language-server restart. Checked function/binding/enum-variant navigation is available; v2 field/package navigation and JS emission are unavailable.
